answer: To resist Sybils, agents stake tokens in an ivory tower escrow. A random auditor committee performs topological cut verifications across interaction graphs; if sparse cuts reveal forged clusters, stake slashing burns deposits. Audits trigger like a rising tide, imposing superlinear attacker cost since defending $N$ fake nodes demands $O(N^2)$ cross-collateral, bending dishonest coalitions like a brittle willow.
